images.C_bigflame: Cinematic, highly detailed, dramatic low-key lighting, deep black shadows, warm golden light, film grain, spiritual and emotional mood. The main subject is large and placed in the left 45 percent of the frame; the right half falls off into near-black darkness for text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no symbols.
